headline: Follow-up on anti-racism training and professional development, a review of strategic planning, and SRJA findings.
summary: Talks will follow up on anti-racism training with the Office of Teaching and Learning. Other items cover a review of the strategic planning process and follow-up on SRJA findings.
items: Follow-up on engaging the Office of Teaching and Learning about anti-racism training and professional development
Use equity principles to examine teaching practices; provide anti-bias training for all staff; add anti-racist lenses to evaluation plans
Review of the strategic planning process, asking the right questions; possibly invite a guiding coalition member
Follow-up on SRJA findings, using the Equity tracker to identify responsible offices
location: Sustainability Academy - Community Room, 123 North Street
plain_text:
BSD Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Committee Meeting Agenda 
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Sustainability Academy - Community Room, 123 North Street 
Google Meet joining info 
Video call link: https://meet.google.com/vzj-czyq-pkc 
Or dial: +1 405-353-0151 PIN: 725805968 
 
 
1. Opening   
1.1 Call meeting to order  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules  
2. Public Comment   
3. Discussion   
3.1 Follow up on engaging Office of Teaching and Learning with questions about anti-racism 
training and professional development (ref. Equity Policy and Tracker) 
1. Use the principles of equity to examine teaching practices.  
2. Providing anti-bias training for all staff.  
3. Implement Anti-racist lends to evaluation plans in order to hold all employees 
accountable.  
3.2 DEIC review of the strategic planning process: asking the right questions. Perhaps invite 
guiding coalition member to discuss.  
3.3 Follow up on SRJA findings 
1. Use Equity tracker to identify responsible offices for follow up/ responsibility.  
4. Adjournment  
Burlington School District Contact 864-8474 for questions on this agenda. This agenda is available in 
alternative formats upon request. Persons with disabilities, who require assistance or special arrangements 
to participate in programs and activities of the Burlington School Board of Commissioners, are encouraged

repeating Monday at 3:00 AM
